sites.name: Shackleton Crater Rim
sites.ice_evidence: High — ShadowCam imagery and M3 water-ice absorption (Hayne et al.)
sites.source: Zuber et al. 2012; Hayne et al. 2015; ShadowCam 2023

sites.name: Cabeus Crater
sites.ice_evidence: Confirmed — LCROSS impactor detected water vapour and ice (Colaprete et al. 2010)
sites.source: Colaprete et al. 2010 Science; Spudis et al. 2013; LOLA LDSM

sites.name: Haworth Crater
sites.ice_evidence: Moderate — Neutron suppression hydrogen signal (LEND instrument)
sites.source: Mitrofanov et al. 2010 (LEND); Hayne et al. 2015

sites.name: Faustini Crater
sites.ice_evidence: High — Mini-RF anomalous CPR and Diviner cold-trap confirmation
sites.source: Spudis et al. 2013; Hayne et al. 2015; Diviner Radiometer

sites.name: Nobile Crater
sites.ice_evidence: Moderate — Selected as Artemis III candidate region; orbital hydrogen signal
sites.source: NASA Artemis III Science Definition Team 2020; Hayne et al. 2015
